fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) declined 36.5% over the past month, but Evercore ISI maintains an Outperform rating with a $2,500 price target, emphasizing structural business changes.
fields.summary_ko.1: NAND price increases have persisted for approximately 6 quarters compared to the historical 2nd quarter, and with gross margins above 80% while maintaining supply discipline, long-term supply contracts with customers are expected to limit downside risk.
